items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Teal was in that band at the Pekin... He's six foot something, you know. His leg crossed, he was the laziest clarinet player I've ever seen in my life. He was playing and they got a newspaper and he stopped playing to turn the page.

ctx.x: Sure. How did you learn how to blow correctly?

Well, I'll tell you one thing, before I even thought about a clarinet, I used to- Oh, I got to tell you I worked with Manu Perez too. You did work for- Yeah, Teal was in that band at the Pekin. Who was in that band?
